name: Billow Wipe
description: The second clip flows over the first like one fluid sliding over another, its front rolling up into a row of curling spirals that wind the two clips into each other, tighten as they sweep across the frame and drift sideways, then leave it. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the front travels toward (x right, y up)

params.name: spacing
params.description: Distance between the curls, in frame heights

params.name: winding
params.description: How many radians the curls wind up while crossing the frame

params.name: drift
params.description: How far the curls drift sideways while crossing, in frame heights
